result.summary: Found 1 visual defect: in the 'Popular right now' section, the Tokumaru Ramen Bar metadata line has two text strings drawn on top of each other, making it illegible. The rest of the layout (header, search, category chips, promo banner, 'Fastest near you' carousel, bottom navigation) renders correctly.

issues.description: The metadata line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' shows two overlapping strings, the delivery time ('25–35 min') and the delivery fee ('€0 delivery'), rendered in the same position. The result reads as garbled text ('25–3€0 mdeilivery'), so users cannot read the delivery time or fee.
issues.suggestion: Lay the metadata items out inline in a single row with separators (e.g., '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen'), matching the 'Fastest near you' cards. Check for absolute positioning or a missing flex/row container on the time and fee text elements, and confirm long values wrap or truncate instead of overlapping.
